strategy.overview: Chicago Cubs 'Triple Play' rewards control of the six-target bank and spinner. Shoot the next lit drop target until the bank completes TRIPLE PLAY, then collect the lit Extra Ball at the hole. Spinner turns register outs and work toward the spinner's TRIPLE PLAY Special, which is collected at the spot target. Each completed inning adds 10,000 to Bonus, while each completed game adds 100,000.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Chicago Cubs 'Triple Play,' shoot the next lit drop target until the six-target bank completes TRIPLE PLAY, then collect Extra Ball at the lit hole. Use the spinner to register outs and finish its TRIPLE PLAY sequence, then hit the lit spot target for Special. Each finished inning adds 10,000 to Bonus.
strategy.summary: Prioritize the next lit drop target because the bank advances the main sequence and opens Extra Ball. Take spinner rips when the feed is safe: they register outs, and completing the spinner's TRIPLE PLAY sequence lights the spot-target Special. Protect inning and game progress for their end-of-ball values.

steps.text: Shoot the next lit target in the six-target bank to advance the controlled TRIPLE PLAY sequence.
Complete TRIPLE PLAY on the bank to light Extra Ball at the hole.
Shoot the lit hole to collect Extra Ball.
Send a controlled shot through the spinner to register outs and advance its TRIPLE PLAY sequence.
Complete the spinner's TRIPLE PLAY sequence, then hit the lit spot target for Special.

alternatives.title: Inning-Bonus route
alternatives.when: Use this when the target bank is dangerous but the spinner feed is repeatable.

steps.text: Use spinner turns to record outs and finish innings.
Preserve the running inning count because each completed inning is worth 10,000 in Bonus.
Return to the target bank when the next lit target is available from a settled flipper.

buildsToward.title: Extra Ball, Special, and completed-game Bonus

steps.text: Finish the six-target TRIPLE PLAY sequence for the lit Extra Ball.
Finish the spinner sequence and collect the spot-target Special.
Complete enough innings to finish a game and add its 100,000-point Bonus.

machineSetup: Confirm the installed ROM revision or field-conversion kit, ball count, Extra Ball and Special conversion, and whether outs, runners, and add-a-runner lamps carry between balls.
Test individual control of all six drop targets, the spinner, Extra Ball hole, spot target, inning lamps, runner lamps, and out lamps.
